decision_reason: The required 390x844 browser probe reproducibly moved the document root and application shell horizontally.

causal_assessment.hypothesis: The requirement page boundary does not clip the global mobile table minimum width.
supporting_evidence: The global mobile rule gives UiDataTable a 680px minimum width.
Before correction, a horizontal gesture changed root scrollLeft from 0 to 122 and app-shell x to -122.
causal_assessment.falsifier: If page-local overflow clipping does not keep root scrollLeft at 0 at all required mobile viewports, this hypothesis is insufficient.

invariants: Do not change business handlers, API calls, data, permissions or action visibility conditions.
Keep the repository's global mobile table minimum width and internal table scrolling policy unchanged.
control_action.impact_limit: Add one page-local overflow-x declaration only.
correction_check: Repeat horizontal gestures at 375x812, 390x844 and 430x932 and assert root scrollLeft remains 0.
Recheck action button overflow and desktop width metrics.
Run git diff --check and npm run build.
